description: Angular component for displaying and interacting with a hierarchy view, including filtering, pinning, and selection of tree nodes.

classes.name: HierarchyComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing a hierarchical tree view with filtering, pinning, and selection features.

methods.name: isFlattened
methods.description: Checks if the tree view should be flattened based on user options.

methods.name: onPinnedNodeClick
methods.description: Handles click events on pinned nodes, updating highlights and selection.

methods.name: updateTree
methods.description: Dispatches an event to update user options for the hierarchy view.

methods.name: filterTree
methods.description: Dispatches an event to filter the hierarchy tree based on filter string.

methods.name: highlightedItemChange
methods.description: Dispatches an event to change the highlighted item in the hierarchy.

methods.name: selectedTreeChange
methods.description: Dispatches an event to change the selected tree node.

methods.name: pinnedItemChange
methods.description: Dispatches an event to change pinned items in the hierarchy.
